# Breakdown review

Breakdown `96326159` correctly brackets container `9b7b5f9c`; its approved design is [9b7b5f9c-plan.md](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/.agents/worktrees/agent-9b7b5f9c/dev/active/9b7b5f9c-plan.md:40).

## Content standards

**Blocking failure — F1, F2.**

All twelve implementation issues have clean titles, kebab-case `epic:jit-profiles` membership, and marked, observable `## Success Criteria`. However, eight descriptions retain prohibited sibling-oriented wording, and `7ad4019b` contains an ambiguous package inventory that cannot be verified without the design document.

## Coverage versus design

All twelve design items are present exactly once; no extra issue appeared in the creation batch.

## Dependency DAG correctness

**Pass.** The direct ordering matches §3 of the design:

- Initial fan-out: `0aec3b1e`, `be542b98`, `866a5bbd`, and `92039d9c`.
- `56838d99 ← {0aec3b1e, be542b98}`
- `eceffc17 ← 866a5bbd`
- `9b0a997e ← {56838d99, eceffc17}`
- `0d8f20a8 ← 0aec3b1e`
- `7ad4019b ← {9b0a997e, 92039d9c, 0d8f20a8}`
- `070ca05f ← 7ad4019b ← …`
- `c533ac18 ← 070ca05f`
- `bcff56be ← c533ac18`

No missing prerequisite or false serialization was found. Each initial task can begin in the existing repository on a fresh workspace; none relies on a crate or directory created by another sibling.

## Structural integrity

**Pass.** The flat `type:task` tier is explicitly justified at [§3](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/.agents/worktrees/agent-9b7b5f9c/dev/active/9b7b5f9c-plan.md:40): the groups are waves, each leaf has an exclusive blast radius and green landing, and the production-payload migration is intentionally atomic to avoid dual inventories. All twelve created issues are reachable from `9b7b5f9c`; none is isolated or dangling.

## Prior review feedback

`run_history` is empty.

## Findings

1. **F1 — Blocking, medium: eight descriptions violate the prohibition on sibling cross-references.** The canonical standard requires standalone descriptions and explicitly bans sibling references ([content standards](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/.agents/worktrees/agent-9b7b5f9c/docs/reference/jit-content-standards.md:60)). Offending `description` text includes `56838d99` (“the overlay-view leaf”), `eceffc17` (“the kernel leaf” and “the exposure leaf”), `9b0a997e` (“its dedicated contract change”), `92039d9c` (“a later leaf”), `0d8f20a8` (“the dependent payload leaf”), `7ad4019b` (“their prerequisite leaf” and “the next leaf”), `070ca05f` (“the prerequisite recovery leaf”), and `bcff56be` (“their owning leaves”). Apply these exact replacements:

   - `56838d99`: replace the scope suffix with “Repository-view implementation and validation-reader migration are outside this task.”
   - `eceffc17`: replace the scope suffix with “This task consumes the existing transaction kernel and does not add profile command syntax.”
   - `9b0a997e`: replace the green-landing suffix with “Public CLI parsing and rendering remain unchanged.”
   - `92039d9c`: replace the background suffix with “These operations remain generic and data-neutral; this task does not select or author the production profile payload.”
   - `0d8f20a8`: replace both “dependent payload leaf” clauses with “Production package content and live-consumer migration are outside this task.”
   - `7ad4019b`: replace the scope suffix with “This task consumes existing renderer and preset-projection APIs without changing their algorithms,” and replace “while the CLI remains private until the next leaf” with “while no public profile CLI is exposed.”
   - `070ca05f`: replace the background/scope ownership prose with “This task consumes the cache-free recovery coordinator without changing recovery classification; adopter documentation is outside scope.”
   - `bcff56be`: replace all “owning leaf/leaves” clauses with “Product defects are reported separately and do not expand this acceptance task; lower-level component tests remain outside this suite.”

2. **F2 — Blocking, high: `7ad4019b.description` is not independently verifiable.** Its REQ-01 says only “taxonomy, bracket, coverage, six gates, review assets, skills, standard, AGENTS regions,” forcing the worker and reviewer to consult the plan to discover the actual inventory. Replace REQ-01 with:

   > - [hard] REQ-01: The production `profiles/jit-dogfood/` manifest and assets contain the milestone, epic, story, task, bug, enhancement, planning, and breakdown taxonomy; the epic-only plan template and enforced epic coverage; the `plan-review`, `breakdown-review`, `code-review`, `coverage-preview`, `jit-validate`, and `repo-validate` gates; their portable prompts, scripts, and structured-warning placeholder; the `jit-manage`, `jit-migrate`, `jit-planning-lead`, `jit-breakdown`, `jit-parallel`, `jit-execution-lead`, and `jit-project-lead` skills; one canonical content-standard asset; managed JIT-guidance and invariant regions for `AGENTS.md`; an empty invariant registry; and complete `invariant_projection` and `rules_gates_projection` singleton contributions. Application preserves all unmanaged bytes.
